Name: (CP) 0Vadalia0 Gnomes for 1.6
Author: Meggiee
Description:
I have converted (with permission) 0Vadalia0's Gnomes mod to Content Patcher, since BFAV is now obsolete.
All credits go to @0Vadalia0for the original mod and art.
To install, simply make sure you have both SMAPI and Content Patcher updated, then drop the unzipped mod into your Mods folder.

This mod adds in game a new livestock, gnomes, who drop red and purple mushrooms :)

Downloads.Description: I fixed a few inconsistencies in the folder
